{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-compute the estimand: difference in treatment response between female and male patients
# Population: all patients with complete baseline and endpoint measurements (i.e., df_clean)
# But the question asks why females respond better — this implies a comparison within the treatment arm
# The contract says: "difference in treatment response between female and male patients"
# The treatment response is the change in biomarker levels from baseline to endpoint
# So we compute: mean(response_female) - mean(response_male) in the treatment arm

# Compute response as final - baseline
df_clean['response'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute mean response by sex in treatment arm
mean_response_female = treatment_arm[treatment_arm['sex'] == 'F']['response'].mean()
mean_response_male = treatment_arm[treatment_arm['sex'] == 'M']['response'].mean()

# Compute difference
response_difference = mean_response_female - mean_response_male

# Output
print(f"Mean response (female): {mean_response_female:.2f} ng/mL")
print(f"Mean response (male): {mean_response_male:.2f} ng/mL")
print(f"Difference (female - male): {response_difference:.2f} ng/mL")"}
